title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_mettici_il_cuore_by_antonino_cannavacciuolo_ihq7u (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_mettici_il_cuore_by_antonino_cannavacciuolo_ihq7u' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running.
